Carnival Cruise Lines Order Management System

Carnival

Summary

End-to-end SAP base e-commerce and order management system.

Challenge

Translate complex cruise order-management needs into an e-commerce workflow that could support business operations end to end.

Solution

Designed flows and interface patterns around order visibility, task clarity, and operational continuity across the SAP-based experience.

Impact

Helped shape a more usable order management experience for teams handling high-volume commerce operations.
